args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
Hi June,

A note from Sofia Marchetti and Bettina Kroll on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026. The CRM code changed from CLR to PHL.
- Watch the PHL code in dropdowns: Pellucid Harbor Logistics also uses PHL.
- Pemberline Dock's export still shows the old name, "Covey & Lark Retail", in some places. This caused a driver to be sent to the office at door 6 on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage check (18 May) says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". The report label needs updating to Pellow Home Living.
- Rows are easy to mix up: the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.
- Ask: please confirm the report label and export template are fixed under the new name.

Thanks,
Bettina
